At a @housescience hearing, I discussed the Corvallis Microfluidics Tech Hub and its exciting work to create more energy-efficient chips.

Oregon is already a leader in semiconductor innovation. This hub will help drive AI and other future tech while meeting our climate goals. https://t.co/tS3cR8u5nG
